body: `pnpm bench` runs `sati init` in temp folders without SATI_REGISTRY, so `sati projects` on the developer's machine fills with sati-bench-* entries. Point the registry at a temp file as the tests do.

completion.summary: The benchmark now points SATI_REGISTRY at a temp file, as the tests do, so its temp projects no longer land in the developer's ~/.sati/projects.json. Checked: `sati projects` listed 20 entries before and after a full bench run; gate green.

title: Benchmark registers its temporary projects in the machine's project list
